title: Magento Conversion
meta: Improvements to product pages, cart and checkout that help more Magento visitors become buyers. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Magento conversion, from product page to checkout
overview: We look at your product pages, cart and checkout the way a first-time buyer does, then fix what slows them down. That can be clearer price and stock messages, better image galleries, trust badges near the buy button, a shorter checkout, guest checkout or clearer shipping costs. We set up funnel tracking so you can see where buyers drop off, and we explain every change. We cannot promise a sales lift.

A full buyer journey pass with email and cart recovery.

faq: Can you promise a higher conversion rate?
No. We remove the usual causes of lost orders and add tracking, so you can see the effect. Results depend on traffic, prices and your offer, and we never claim a set percentage.
Will changes slow down my checkout?
We test each change for speed and function. Checkout is the most sensitive part of Magento, so we work on staging, test real orders and only deploy when everything works with your payment methods.
Do you need to change my payment gateway?
Rarely. We work with what you have. If your gateway causes a lot of failed payments, we point this out and suggest an option, but any switch is your decision.
Premium comes with a plan for tests. Actual split testing needs enough traffic and often a testing tool you pay for. We tell you whether your traffic supports it before suggesting one.
